title: A market that follows you
summary: Choose the sectors you follow and discover stocks in a For You section on Markets. Set your email preferences for the Morning Brief and Breaking News as delivery prepares to launch.

items.title: Start with your interests
items.description: Choose sectors during signup or update them in Settings. Personalization is optional, and you can change your choices later.

items.title: Discover stocks picked for your sectors
items.description: For You highlights stocks from your selected sectors while the full market and search remain available.

items.title: Choose what reaches your inbox
items.description: Morning Brief and Breaking News have separate opt-ins, both off by default. Choose a daily brief time and time zone, or turn either preference off in Settings. Email delivery is still in rollout; saving a preference does not start emails yet.

video.label: Personalized Markets and the upcoming Morning Brief, a 24-second Oren film
video.caption: A look at personalized Markets and the upcoming Morning Brief. The film shows sample portfolio figures; email delivery is still in rollout.
